g.text: Docker Compose — profile: core; optional: storage
Docker Compose — profiles: gpu, optional ollama
The GPU host opens no public ports and reaches
the main host only over the private network.
It holds no database or storage credentials:
audio is fetched through presigned URLs.
Only nginx (80 redirect, 443 HTTPS) and the private network's endpoint
are exposed. Single-host deployment runs both Compose
profiles on one GPU machine, without the private network.
only when the Owner configured a key
[TB-1] User-controlled clients to public Whadio entry point
[TB-2] Extension to third-party Google Meet page
[TB-3] TLS-terminating proxy to internal web app
[TB-6] Main host to lower-trust GPU host over private mesh
[TB-7] Whadio to external BYOK LLM provider
